Realized investment gains (losses)

The Realized Investment Gains & Losses report shows gains and losses from investments that have been sold or disposed of during a specified period.

This report calculates the actual profit or loss realized when investments are sold by comparing the sale proceeds with the average cost of the investments.

Each disposal transaction is listed with the quantity sold, the average cost per unit, total cost basis, consideration received, and the resulting gain or loss.

Gains are shown as positive amounts, while losses are shown in parentheses. The report provides a total of all realized gains and losses for the selected period.

For more information, see: Realized Currency Gains and Losses — Edit
